interpretation: Terminal collection crossed the test deadline and left a deferred observer queued. This identifies the failure boundary; accumulated scheduling delay in 200 relative sleeps is supported but the OS root cause is not independently proven.
fix: Only the responsiveness fixture changes from 200 x 10ms sleeps to 1 x 2000ms sleep. Same nominal hold, original sub250ms submission/10heartbeats/10s completion and all result/lifecycle assertions. No product, FFI, dependency, cancellation or progress-test change.
review: Focused independent review approves scope; one sleep can still overshoot, so no exact scheduler-timing guarantee.
